$comment: Seasonal clusters. Guides opt into these by tag; a cluster with no guides is skipped at build time so the site never ships an empty shelf.

holiday-cooking.name: Holiday cooking
holiday-cooking.why: The one week a year when a second oven stops being a luxury and starts being a plan.

weeknight.name: Weeknight
weeknight.why: Fast, quiet, and washable — the three things that decide whether a gadget survives February.

batch-cooking.name: Batch cooking
batch-cooking.why: Volume, single-layer truth, and what you do with four trays on a Sunday.

small-kitchen.name: Small kitchens
small-kitchen.why: Where clearance and cord length outrank every feature on the box.

dorm-and-rental.name: Dorm & rental
dorm-and-rental.why: Low wattage, one hand on the controls, and nothing that needs a landlord's approval.

evergreen.name: Evergreen
evergreen.why: The reading skills and thresholds that do not go out of date.
